name: Clever Magic
source:
Main character is a charismatic hairdresser in a beauty salon for celebrities. He uses his skill to drag the visiting guests one after another to the world of desire.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是名流美容院里一名极具魅力的发型师。他利用自己的技巧，把前来光顾的客人一个接一个引入欲望世界。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
